Neymar Jr. Acquires Luxury Watch Amidst World Cup Preparations

Brazilian football star Neymar Jr. has reportedly added a Jacob & Co. Astronomia Dragon & Tiger watch, valued at approximately $1 million and featuring 286 diamonds, to his extensive luxury watch collection. This acquisition comes as he participates in the FIFA World Cup 2026 qualifiers with the Brazil squad. One report also mentions a significant donation he made to aid Venezuelan earthquake victims.
